**Amazon FY2024 total revenue (net sales)**

Amazon reports total revenue on the line item "Net sales" in its Consolidated Statements of Operations. For fiscal year 2024 (the year ended December 31, 2024), net sales were **$637,959 million (~$638.0 billion)** [DOC: amzn_10k_fy2024.txt — "CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS (in millions) — Net sales, fiscal year 2024: $637,959"].

Context from the same statement:
- FY2023 net sales: $574,785 million [DOC: amzn_10k_fy2024.txt]
- FY2022 net sales: $513,983 million [DOC: amzn_10k_fy2024.txt]

That implies year-over-year growth of about **11.0%** in FY2024 ($637,959 ÷ $574,785 − 1).

Comparability note: Amazon's fiscal year ends December 31, so FY2024 is a clean calendar-year figure, and the FY2023/FY2022 comparatives are presented within the same FY2024 10-K on a consistent basis — no fiscal-year mismatch or restatement issue affects this comparison based on the excerpts available.

ANSWER: $637,959 million (approximately $638.0 billion) in net sales for fiscal year 2024
